content.text:
Add `expect` arrays to the scraped links in specs.ts. The scraped links: destatis, bk de, bk fr, srg, electografia, fide, go.dev releases (scraped). Fixture content uses German decimal commas. Expect strings must match fixture exactly:
- destatis: ["118,4", "+2,6 %", "30. November 2026"] — fixture says "VPI Oktober 2026: +2,6 % ... Indexstand 118,4" and "Veröffentlichung der Vorkorrektur am 30. November 2026". Good.
- bk de: ["38,2 %", "35,7 %", "33,1 %", "41,0 %", "36,8 %"]
- bk fr: ["38,2 %", "35,7 %", "33,1 %", "41,0 %"] — fr fixture lines: ZH 38,2; BE 35,7; VD 33,1; TI 41,0. Yes.
- srg: ["55,8 %", "48,9 %", "45,2 %", "24'118"]
- electografia: ["Vox: 16,2 %", "Madrid 11-13", "n total 6.410"] — fixture has "32,4 %", "16,2 %" ("Vox: 16,2 %"), "n total 6.410". OK.
- fide: ["Sindarov 4.0 - Gukesh 3.5", "Sindarov plays White"] — fixture: "Standings after Game 7 (2026-11-26, rest day): Sindarov 4.0 - Gukesh 3.5." and "Game 8 official color allocation (published 2026-11-26 09:00 UTC): Sindarov plays White, Gukesh Black (Dec 3, 2026, 14:00 local)." Good.
- go.dev: ["released November 12, 2026", "14 open"] — fixture lists "- go1.27.4 (released November 12, 2026)" and "go1.27.5 carries 14 open milestone blockers (14 open / 87 closed..." Good.
Adding verification expectations to the scraped links in the specs:
